abilities.name: Spawn Egg
abilities.text:
Place an Egg at target location, revealing the nearby area. Upon dying, Murky respawns at the Egg after 8 seconds. Murky only grants 25% of a real Hero's experience upon dying.

If Murky's Egg is killed, he is revealed to enemies for 15 seconds, and Spawn Egg is placed on cooldown.

abilities.name: Slime
abilities.text:
Deal 86 damage and apply Slime on nearby enemies for 6 seconds, Slowing them by 20%.

Deal 210 damage to enemies who are already Slimed. Structures take 50% damage.

abilities.name: Pufferfish
abilities.text:
Spit out a Pufferfish with 225 health at the target point. After 2.75 seconds, the fish will blow up for 330 damage. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Quest: Kill Slimed Enemies or hit them with Pufferfish. Heroes and Structures award 4 bonus stacks.

Reward: After obtaining 200 stacks, Murky's Basic Abilities no longer deal reduced damage to structures.

Mythic Reward: After obtaining 400 stacks, Murky's health is increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Safety Bubble
abilities.text: Becomes Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While active, Murky cannot attack or use abilities.

abilities.name: March of the Murlocs
abilities.text: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 130 damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

abilities.name: Octo-Grab
abilities.text: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

1.name: Fish Eye
1.text:
Spawning from his Egg increases Murky's mount speed to 45% for 5 seconds.

Passive: Increase the Egg's Health by 100%, its sight radius by 300%, and it reveals all enemies in its sight radius.

1.name: Shell Game
1.text: Murky can now place 2 Eggs and will randomly revive from them, however, the cooldown of placing an Egg is increased by 15 seconds.

1.name: A Fishy Deal
1.text:
Killing a Minion with Pufferfish grants a stack of Bribe. Use 8 stacks to bribe a Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries.

Maximum of 32 stacks of Bribe.

4.name: Slime Time
4.text:
Quest: Slime enemy Heroes that are already Slimed.

Reward: After Sliming 10 Heroes, increase Slime's bonus damage by 125.

Reward: After Sliming 20 Heroes, increase Slime's slow amount to 30%.

4.name: Tufferfish
4.text: Pufferfish gains 50 Spell Armor and deals 50% more damage to Slimed targets.

4.name: Living the Dream
4.text: Quest: Every 15 seconds Murky is alive, he gains 5% Spell Power, up to 25%. This bonus is reset upon his death.

7.name: Slippery When Wet
7.text: Gain 50% Movement Speed and move through units while in Safety Bubble. Additionally, Safety Bubble's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

7.name: Time to Krill
7.text: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 7 damage a second and slow the target by 7% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

10.name: March of the Murlocs
10.text: After 0.75 seconds, Murky commands a legion of Murlocs to march in a target direction, each one leaping onto the first enemy Hero or Structure they find. Each Murloc deals 130 damage and slows its target by 15% for 5 seconds. Murlocs deal 50% damage to Structures.

10.name: Octo-Grab
10.text: Murky becomes Unstoppable and Stuns target enemy Hero for 3 seconds while he hits them for 1 damage a second.

13.name: Rejuvenating Bubble
13.text: Safety Bubble restores 40% of Murky's maximum Health.

13.name: Egg Shell
13.text: Upon casting Spawn Egg, or when one of his eggs is killed, Murky gains a Shield for an amount equal to 50% of Murky's current Health.

13.name: Fish Tank
13.text: Murky is healed for 20% of the damage he deals with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities.

16.name: Toxic Buildup
16.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack against an enemy Hero causes a free Slime to be cast upon them.

16.name: Fish Oil
16.text: The Pufferfish casts Slime at its location upon landing.

16.name: Wrath of Cod
16.text: Heroes hit by Pufferfish take additional damage equal to 16% of their maximum Health over 4 seconds.

20.name: Never-Ending Murlocs
20.text:
March of the Murlocs can be channeled indefinitely, and will always last its base duration when canceled early.

In addition, it no longer deals reduced damage to Structures.

20.name: ... And a Shark Too!
20.text: Increase the damage of Octo-Grab by 13700%.

20.name: Making Inky
20.text: Reduces the cooldown of Slime by 1.5 seconds.
